name: usage-rings
description: Claude plan usage rings with reset times, what your Claude Code and Cowork usage would cost at API prices, a leaderboard of your most expensive sessions, spend alerts, and fire-and-money graphics.

seatPrice.title: Seat price (US$ per month)
seatPrice.description: What your Claude seat costs a month, to compare against what your usage would cost at API prices. 0 leaves the comparison out.

sessionWarn.title: Alert: session passes (US$)
sessionWarn.description: First alert when one session's cost at API prices passes this. 0 turns it off.

sessionHot.title: Alert: session hot (US$)
sessionHot.description: Second alert, with a Mac notification, when one session passes this.

sessionFire.title: Alert: session on fire (US$)
sessionFire.description: Third alert, with a Mac notification and full fire, when one session passes this.

turnAlert.title: Alert: one reply costs more than (US$)
turnAlert.description: Alert when a single reply costs more than this at API prices. 0 turns it off.

burnAlert.title: Alert: spending per hour over (US$)
burnAlert.description: Alert when this session spends more than this within an hour. 0 turns it off.

ringAlert.title: Alert: plan limit passes (%)
ringAlert.description: Alert when the 5-hour or weekly limit passes this percent (and again at 95%). 0 turns it off.

funMode.title: Fun mode
funMode.description: Animated fire, a ticking money counter and falling money when a session passes a milestone.

sound.title: Cha-ching sound
sound.description: Play a cash-register sound when a session passes a milestone (macOS).
